svg.title: Which MVCC defects did candidate-written tests detect?
svg.desc: All thirty-six MVCC attempts and all six fixed injected defects. Detected means an executed assertion failure on a mutant with passing candidate and reference controls. Missed means the valid tests passed the mutant. No-added-tests is a scored zero with no submitted tests. Unavailable is an unusable evaluation and has no numerical score. Sol 6 Max repetition two is unavailable. Colors and cell labels distinguish all four states.
svg.text: Which MVCC defects did the tests detect?
Every attempt is shown; each column is one frozen contract mutation
Detected: candidate tests pass the implementation and positive control, then fail a mutant by assertion.
No added tests: numerical zero sensitivity. Unavailable: no numerical score; it is never replaced by zero.
Six fixed defects are a limited testing sample. Two attempts per setting show observations, not confidence intervals.
